# Carefolio Index

> Carefolio Index is an independent research framework for comparing the employer policies that shape life around work.

Care Scores are calculated from a versioned 16-signal methodology. Scores use publicly available employer information and company-submitted evidence, are reviewed monthly, and are a research aid rather than an endorsement or guarantee of individual employee experience.

## Core pages

- [Company directory](https://www.carefolio.io/directory): Ranked employer records with Care Scores, evidence status and review dates.
- [Care Score methodology](https://www.carefolio.io/methodology): The complete versioned 16-signal calculation and review rules.
- [Corrections process](https://www.carefolio.io/corrections): How employers can submit evidence or request a correction.

## Related products

- [RemoteShe](https://www.remoteshe.co): A separate job board that uses Carefolio score and company-benefit information.
- [MomOps](https://www.momops.org): Supplies the care lens framework.
